sentences.text: Heard on I.A.No.4740/2025 which is third (repeat) application under Section 389(1) of Code of Criminal Procedure, 1973 filed on behalf of the appellant - Devraj @ Pintu for grant of bail and suspension of remaining jail sentence.

2. Appellant has been convicted for offence punishable under Sections 363, 366, 376(2)(n) of the Indian Penal Code and Section 5(L)/6 and 5(J)(II) of the POCSO Act and sentenced to undergo R.I.
for 5 years with fine of Rs. 2,000/-, R.I. for 7 years with fine of Rs. 2,000/-, L.I. with fine of Rs.
5,000/- and L.I. with fine of Rs. 5,000/- and default stipulation.
3.
As per the case of the prosecution, on 03.08.2020, present appellant took the prosecutrix with him to his house to celebrate the Sankranti Festival.

After the festival, present appellant forcibly raped the prosecutrix multiple times over a period of one and a half months, threatening her life and the lives of her family members to ensure her silence.
After returning home prosecutrix asked her mother to bring medicine for stomach ache.
The present appellant took the prosecutrix with him to various places after prosecutrix mother left her alone at home.
Later, prosecutrix informed her family about her whereabout after her health got worsen.
Upon recovery 2 CRA-500-2017 prosecutrix was taken to hospital where she was told to be 2 months pregnant.
Thereafter, her statements u/s 164 were recorded and trial initiated against present applicant u/s 363, 366 376(2)(n) of I.P.C. and 5(L) r/w 6 and 5(J)(I) of POCSO Act.
Ld. Trial Court convicted the present applicant as above mentioned.
4. Learned counsel for the appellant submits that the appellant has been falsely implicated in the case.
Age of the prosecutrix at the time of incident has been found 17 years 2 months.
The conviction of the appellant is solely upon false allegations made by prosecutrix and there is no direct evidence against the present appellant.
Appellant is in custody since 01.04.2015 and has completed more than 10 years of jail incarceration.
Appeal is of the year 2017 and its final disposal will take considerable time.

sentences.text: Hence, in such circumstances, prayer is made for suspension of the jail sentence and grant of bail.
5. Learned counsel for the respondent / State opposes the application and prays for its rejection.

6. Considering the facts and circumstances of the case and arguments advanced by learned counsel for the parties, without commenting on the merits of the case, this Court is of the considered opinion that the application for suspension of custodial sentence filed on behalf of the appellant deserves to be allowed.
7. Accordingly, I.A.No.4740/2025 is allowed and the execution of remaining jail sentence of the appellant is hereby suspended till final disposal of this appeal.

It is directed that appellant - Devraj @ Pintu be 3 CRA-500-2017 released on bail subject to depositing the fine amount, if not already deposited and upon furnishing a personal bond in the sum of Rs.50,000/- (Rupees Fifty Thousand Only) with one solvent surety of the like amount to the satisfaction of the trial Court, with a further direction to appear before the Registry of this Court on 08.10.2025 and on such other dates, as may be fixed by the Registry of this Court in this regard during the pendency of this appeal.
8. List for final hearing in due course.
Certified copy as per rules.

(VIVEK RUSIA) (GAJEN  JUDGE J  Vatan Devraj @ Pintu vs The State Of Madhya Pradesh on 7 May, 2025 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/111153644/
